assumptions: The file is MGF as pyteomics reads it.
limits: Reads what the file says, including a declared charge that may be wrong.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A reader: the spectra as the MGF file writes them, with nothing inferred; the Mass spec panel's readings are on the tools that score them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What spectra does this MGF file hold?

description: Read the MS/MS spectra of a Mascot Generic Format (MGF) file: each spectrum's title, precursor m/z, precursor intensity, declared charge states and peak list, interpreted as pyteomics reads MGF (validated on every spectrum of PXD000001). A spectrum it returns is what score_spectrum takes as mz, intensity and precursorCharge.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

title.description: return only the spectrum with this title; empty returns every spectrum.

name: read_mgf

spectra.description: one row per spectrum: title, precursorMz, precursorIntensity, charges, mz, intensity
